UAT: **focused-test-pass-1**

`nheroux-bit` cannot apply labels on this repo (`AddLabelsToLabelable` denied). Please add the `focused-test-pass-1` label to this issue.

Adoption blocker.

This is about Planning: the conversation before any code. Directive is supposed to learn what the person wants, write down the project, and agree the scope before an agent starts building.

What a new person hits: The product tells them not to repeat the interview, then asks for the same answers again.

Why that ruins the product for them: It feels careless. They already gave their time, and the tool did not remember, then blamed them for not repeating it.

How likely: High for people who get through the interview once. It lands in the same first session as the save failure.

Recorded refutation-target on #issuecomment-5782790736:

> When USER.md already exists, setup still asks the operator to re-provide interview answers because project-level answers were never stored and the resume path treats the empty PROJECT-DEFINITION seed as missing product answers.

The write-back's pin-read of the setup skill matches the file. A fresh USER.md skips Phase 1, and a skipped Phase 1 asks the depth question again. Those sentences are the track rule. The because-clause names a resume classifier this tree does not contain.

## Empty seed is a file that exists

blocks-the-design

Evidence. Pin-read at b6425115eab5a25877735acd70ca7d693594dda8.

Session routing sends setup to Phase 1/2 when USER.md or PROJECT-DEFINITION is missing, and otherwise reads the file that is there (`missing USER.md / PROJECT-DEFINITION → setup Phase 1/2` in content/templates/agents-entry.md; the same sentence is locked in packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills/agents_md.test.ts). `seedMinimalProjectDefinition` in packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-deposit.ts writes PROJECT-DEFINITION only when the file is absent, and leaves an existing file intact. The init next-step tells the agent to run `task project:render` once and to keep that refresh off identity invention. content/commands.md, Multi-scope turn/cache budget (#3009), states the same rule: the init seed is a minimal render-ready PROJECT-DEFINITION, and `project:render` is a one-shot lifecycle refresh, not identity research (#3013).

The bytes of that seed are `createSkeleton`. `SKELETON_NARRATIVES` in packages/core/src/render/constants.ts sets Overview, tech stack, Architecture, RisksAndUnknowns, and Configuration to empty strings. When the file already exists, `renderProjectDefinition` in packages/core/src/render/project-render.ts refreshes `plan.items` and staleness flags and leaves narratives as they are.

Phase 2 in content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md skips when `./xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` exists and the operator does not want to replace it. Project answers are that phase's confirmed write: the Output Path template, then the Post-Interview Confirmation Gate (explicit yes, confirmed, or approve). A search of this tree finds no product instruction with the text "previous setup summary", "saved product answers", or "repeat the interview". The issue body records those words as what the agent said.

The open siblings named from the write-back are the write refuses. REST titles: #4660 "Setup interview cannot persist: no host session identity / read-only session:start"; #4663 "Setup cannot write PROJECT-DEFINITION: requirements posture vs mutation needing an active xBRIEF". An untouched seed is what a refused write leaves on disk.

Failure mode. Binding the target as written authorizes a new seed-versus-answers detector, or a second store of project answers, aimed at a resume rule that is absent from the skill, the session-routing sentence, and the seed writer. That detector would sit beside the Phase 2 write #4660 and #4663 already say is refusing, and the track question would remain. Accepting a pasted "previous setup summary" from the tester transcript would also promote untrusted session text into project identity. The confirmation gate and the seed writer's refusal to overwrite are the controls that already bound that write.

Disposition. This refutation-target cannot bind as the cause. The bindable residue is a premise that names a control present at this SHA. The #3013 seed is those empty strings behind a file-exists check.

Road not taken. The closest prose is the returning-user menu line that recommends Continue to Phase 2 "when project config is still missing." The Phase 2 skip beside it is a should-level rule. Read against empty skeleton strings, that line can send an agent back into Phase 2, which is the steelman of the target. It remains an undefined recommendation next to the existence skip. The verdict flips if a pin-read at this SHA shows an instruction that empty skeleton narratives mean the product answers are missing and the operator must re-supply the interview. That instruction is absent from the setup skill, the session-routing sentence, and the seed writer.

## Track question is the specified repeat

sharpens-framing

Evidence. Same skill, Track Detection: when Phase 1 was skipped because USER.md already existed, the track is unknown, and Phase 2 asks "How deep do you want to go?" before any Phase 2 question. The skill forbids taking the track from USER.md, including from strategy or coverage. Freshness Detection's expected USER.md fields are Name, Custom Rules, Default Strategy, and optional Coverage and Experimental Rules. The track is not one of those fields, and it is not a PROJECT-DEFINITION narrative. Phase 1 Step 0 uses the same question text on a first interview. Phase 2 fields that already have a USER.md value are asked as keep-or-change. Phase 3's identity-only detector (empty `plan.items` and no scope file) defaults to starting a new specification and forbids synthesizing the first scope from the init seed. That path asks what to build.

Failure mode. A change that drops every question once USER.md exists also drops this required track question. Filling the seed, or teaching the agent that the seed counts as finished identity, leaves the question in place. Its predicate is that Phase 1 was skipped, and it is asked before Phase 2 questions whatever the narratives contain.

Disposition. The track question can bind as its own premise: one specified question, with inference from USER.md forbidden. The recorded because-clause stays unbound. The named pain stays the operator being asked again. This heading is the cause a later premise may state.

## Re-checked anchors

footnote

CHANGELOG.md at this SHA does not name 4668. The issue timeline through this input has labels, three comments (5705170143, 5780266411, 5782790736), and a cross-reference. It has no connected pull request.

metadata.issueBody:
## Tester 1 (Codex / Windows / @deftai/directive@0.119.1)

**Defect:** 15

### Expected
If USER.md exists, setup resumes without re-asking Phase 1.

### What happened
New session: "Do not repeat the interview." Then: no saved product answers in the workspace (PD still empty seed), please provide the previous setup summary. USER.md had name/strategy; project-level answers were never persisted.

### Evidence
Third Codex session transcript.

### Environment
Directive 0.119.1.
